alternatives.contract_value: $120,000,000 Maximum Development Costs (SFJ funding obligation, Section 4.1) and the component Approval Payment totals ($330,000,000 FDA, $210,000,000 EMA, $60,000,000 Japan/China) are also stated. The $600,000,000 grand Total of the Approval Payment Schedule is used because Section 6.1 frames the Approval Payments as the exchange for the Trial Data Package and Section 11.1.1.4 calls them consideration; the amount is contingent on Regulatory Approval and adjustable under Section 6.2.
alternatives.party_roles: Section 2.2.1 names each Party as sponsor of the Clinical Trials in its own Territory. No licensor/licensee, supplier/customer or service-provider role is stated, and Section 15.13.1 disclaims partnership, agency and franchise.
alternatives.expiration_date: The Term has no calendar end date: Section 14.1 ends it on the earliest of termination or payment of the last Approval Payment; the Development Term ends on trial completion or regulatory efforts (Section 1.1.60).
